trigger: U60's frame omitted HTTPClientTransfer.swift, without which its 16 MiB cap and not-covered statuses could not be met (DECISIONS #42, amendment A07).
lesson: An acceptance criterion about runtime behaviour (a size cap, a status mapping) is only reachable if the frame includes the layer that enforces it, not just the layer that declares it.
how_to_apply: When writing a frame, trace each acceptance criterion to the code that actually enforces it (follow the call into transport/storage layers) and include those files, or split the criterion into a dependent unit.
